summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image function, the three thin ignite adapters, and the renamed-parameter callers and tests, all by reading and editing only. Nothing was run, committed, or installed, so test results and flake8 are unverified. Open risk: the classification handler's bound-method registration with ignite 0.3.0 has not been exercised. A stray empty /tmp/unused_marker file was created outside the repo and can be deleted.
